blocks.title: Microscopic waqiat
blocks.text: Microscopic waqiat woh mazahir hain jo nangi aankh se nahi dekhe ja sakte.
Molecules ke darmiyan takrao, bonds ka tootna aur banna, molecules mein atoms ki dobara tarteeb, aur electrons ka khona ya pana microscopic waqiat ki misalein hain.

blocks.prompt: Macroscopic aur microscopic waqiat mein farq batayein, magnesium ke jalne se har ek ki ek misal dete hue.
blocks.explanation: Macroscopic waqiat nazar aate hain: magnesium roshan safed sholay se jalta hai, hararat deta hai aur safed powder chhorta hai. Microscopic waqiat nazar nahi aate: magnesium atoms oxygen atoms ko electrons dete hain, O2 ke bonds tootte aur naye Mg-O bonds bante hain. Nazar aane wali tabdeeliyan an-ginat na-nazar tabdeeliyon ka majmooa hain.

items: Microscopic waqiat dekhe nahi ja sakte: molecular takrao, bonds ka tootna aur banna, atoms ki dobara tarteeb, electrons ka khona ya pana.
